title: PYCT 28: Circular Arrangement
series_name: SSC MTS & Havaldar Mock Test Series 2025
subject: reasoning

questions.question:
Eight friends, J, K, L, M, N, O, P, and Q are sitting around a round table facing the centre (but not necessarily in the same order). K is an immediate neighbour of both Q and M. N is an immediate neighbour of both P and J. L is sitting immediately right to J. K is sitting at the immediate left of Q and is second to the right of O.

Who is sitting to the immediate right of M?
questions.solution: Given: Eight friends, J, K, L, M, N, O, P, and Q are sitting around a round table facing the centre 1) K is sitting at the immediate left of Q and is second to the right of O. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/0fa7e7e08f9d997766a9de9ed543b2cac7ea7a39e820cbb07c5367070dc07722.png] 2) K is an immediate neighbour of both Q and M.

questions.question:
U, V, W, X, Y, Z and A are sitting around a circular table facing the centre (but not necessarily in the same order).

X sits third to the left of Y. W sits second to the left of V. Only Y sits between A and W. U is not an immediate neighbour of X.

Who sits fourth to the right of Z?
questions.solution:
Given, U, V, W, X, Y, Z and A are sitting around a circular table facing the centre (but not necessarily in the same order).

W sits second to the left of V. 

Only Y sits between A and W.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/1e0abcad83e579d5dc6f6763b76082b2ceb8e08b3095bc1183a92f37ccb43c63.png] [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/19e580e289769c1b6c6ca6ca3e3d4251e308578aba5e382be3a33401d5ca3d1f.png] 

X sits third to the left of Y.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/a388a728c0ab9f53894c19bc2ddfabb114bcf8e8eda4046814633a461aeb59ed.png] [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c30ed4aeb1cb680e006d9beca9b6c49ea04f251fd8440eff46e67520d5f0fa15.png] 

U is not an immediate neighbour of X.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c6658de94b409ef0bf4cc0a971c053063f93e37e626ce746e448fc9c41800873.png] [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/5e151bfc0ac90e7d016bd15048dd9520b60f8ae9b6b18400968b167ff768f208.png] 

And Z sits at the remaining place.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/481b472af5d44e2dea8225924beaa566598a616a1b5bf77c867b162f0a90903c.png] [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/44a8f2d75ad49f7ceac8f697d0f5996d60a28f03a5189d1567e1f4d2782d2e6e.png] 

**U sits fourth to the right of Z.**

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 4".

questions.question: Five girls namely B, H, O, M and S are seating in a circle facing the centre. S is sitting to the immediate left of O and the immediate right of B. M sits second to the left of S. Who sits to the immediate right of H?
questions.solution:
Five girls namely **B, H, O, M and S** are seating in a circle facing the centre.

1. S is sitting to the immediate left of O and the immediate right of B.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/12d32c2e3216bdbb95a168995fccb25132357dc2a180d7d30504ee0356d625e8.png] 

2. M sits second to the left of S.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a91e20b54c2342262c95609b3cb258f9effc23a44b31b59d9847d3e370eeda8.png] 

H, the only person left will occupy the vacant position.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4777c67546ca9332d3f396f1f14538d2f0381d93b09d677bb146b1e7262f6e30.png] 

Clearly, M sits to the immediate right of H.

Hence, the correct answer is **"M"**.

questions.question: Seven girls A, B, C, D, E, F and G are sitting around a circular table facing opposite to the centre (not necessarily in the same order). D is second to the right of G. G is third to the right of C. F is third to the right of B. A is not the immediate neighbour of C. E is the immediate neighbour of C. Who is second to the right of A?
questions.solution:
Seven girls A, B, C, D, E, F and G are sitting around a circular table facing opposite to the centre (not necessarily in the same order).

1) D is second to the right of G and G is third to the right of C.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/a0c9e4434f701602f12e8d6d8c2b96663e763a860b56fc6e3e99cb3e9d496290.png] 

2) F is third to the right of B and A is not the immediate neighbour of C and E is the immediate neighbour of C.

Case (i) :

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/60a16acd30e8e885c5043fe0ac501da1ea5bf57774371fb8a9f6012643db1ea3.png] 

Case (ii) :

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/16c3c79bbf05d15a5914f2ac6860e256310c02215565ac878e6931b74042c90f.png] 

From Case (i) and case (ii) second to right of 'A' has to be either B or F. In given option there is no 'F'

∴ By considering Case(ii) 'B' is second to right of 'A'.

Hence, the correct answer is **"B".**

questions.question:
Seven boys Laxman, Mohan, Bit, Sohil. Rahul, Ram and Ramesh are sitting around a circular table facing towards the centre (not necessarily in the same order). Sohil is third to the left of Bittu. Mohan is second to the right of Bittu. Ram is third to the right of Ramesh. Ramesh is not the immediate neighbour of Mohan. Laxman is third to the left of Rahul.

Who is to the immediate left of Ram?
questions.solution:
**Given :** Seven boys Laxman, Mohan, Bit, Sohil. Rahul, Ram and Ramesh are sitting around a circular table facing towards the centre.

**Explanation : **

1) Sohil is third to the left of Bittu.

2) Mohan is second to the right of Bittu.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/49339698f31c215da90edb1691c0dde3d671957af41ade321af7d97894b34397.png] 

3) Ramesh is not the immediate neighbour of Mohan.

4) Ram is third to the right of Ramesh. 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/9cac8fc80e63f9c1ac837f3cd8a2bc54cd8be053f42c5e13442d22af788219ce.png] 

5) Laxman is third to the left of Rahul.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/753c812b568d195790c46806b7748bb084561db45a7f887a6a8da3375c1e70d0.png] 

Thus, according to the final arrangement Bittu is to the immediate left of Ram.

Hence, "**Bittu**" is the correct answer.

questions.question:
Adesh, Rinki, Narendra, Priya, Kiara, Sahil, and Lakshmi are sitting around a circular table, facing the centre (but not necessarily in the same order).

Kiara sits third to the left of Sahil. Rinki sits to the immediate right of Priya, who sits with Sahil. Adesh sits second to the right of Lakshmi.

Who is sitting to the immediate left of Adesh?
questions.solution:
Given:

Adesh, Rinki, Narendra, Priya, Kiara, Sahil, and Lakshmi are sitting around a circular table, facing the centre.

Kiara sits third to the left of Sahil.

Rinki sits to the immediate right of Priya, who sits with Sahil.

Adesh sits second to the right of Lakshmi.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/b0d8a37642737e12888b4289fda81e95bace2e49f52558c3c3c0f7e417e29802.png] [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ff8e9d6baab34f6e00c9fbdfafbf29ad9e632263632d80c3b739e5343de87cdf.png] 

Thus, Kiara is sitting to the immediate left of Adesh.

Hence, the correct answer is **"Option 3".**

questions.question:
Six people A, B, C, D, E and F are sitting around a circular table, facing the centre (but not necessarily in the same order). F is sitting third to the right of C. D is sitting second to the right of A. A and E are immediate neighbours. E is sitting second to the right of B.

How many people are sitting between E and C when counted from the left of E?
questions.solution:
Given:

Six people A, B, C, D, E and F are sitting around a circular table, facing the centre.

D is sitting second to the right of A.

A and E are immediate neighbours.

E is sitting second to the right of B.

F is sitting third to the right of C.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/10746b52f0532e110d89efa8bf5ef626a9a75e915cf59d800532af8635c54c84.png] [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7fc1a2a737c918e946dc47dda9014484d39a452d697450d92329361062fad2d5.png] 

Thus, 3 people are sitting between E and C when counted from the left of E.

Hence, the correct answer is **"Option 1".**

questions.question: Six girls Mansi, Shweta, Monika, Payal, Aarti and Kajal are sitting around a circular table facing towards the centre (not necessarily in the same order). Kajal is to immediate left of Mansi. Shweta is third to the left of Mansi. Payal is second to the right of Kajal, Monika is not second to the left of Mansi. Who is second to the right of Mansi?
questions.solution: As per the given information: 1. Kajal is to the immediate left of Mansi. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/1a52a6c6d67ec02e064c7cfda600f477de18d36df4970d9e5674fe3be7c713b4.png] 2. Shweta is third to the left of Mansi. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/59f940476dcbf0105bf9848705a6e4f36e1133650ab6c70ba3fcdaea8498cbe5.png] 3. Payal is second to the right of Kajal.

questions.question: Eight friends Mansi, Shweta, Monika, Payal, Aarti, Kajal, Laxmi and Rani are sitting around a circular table facing towards the centre (not necessarily in the same order). Mansi is third to the left of Monika. Aarti is second to the right of Monika. Shweta is fourth to the left of Payal. Payal is second to the left of Mansi. Rani is third to the right of Kajal. Kajal is not the immediate neighbour of Mansi. Who is second to the left of Monika?
questions.solution:
Given: Eight friends Mansi, Shweta, Monika, Payal, Aarti, Kajal, Laxmi and Rani are sitting around a circular table facing towards the centre (not necessarily in the same order).

1) Mansi is third to the left of Monika.

2) Aarti is second to the right of Monika.

3) Payal is second to the left of Mansi.

4) Shweta is fourth to the left of Payal. 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/b0e472507f39aae23374a212eb1acb60e5cf9e2e080b216b46f5ed67da08451f.png] 

5) Rani is third to the right of Kajal.

6) Kajal is not the immediate neighbour of Mansi.

And, Laxmi will sit on the remaining place.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/06f0ed85add21b39f37b83462b4a935eb19a37f507116716795e25cba093dd9c.png] 

Here, "Laxmi" is second to the left of Monika.

Hence, the correct answer is **"Option 1"**.

questions.question: Six teachers Anil, Kamal, Ram, Sanjay, Aakash and Vivek are sitting around a circular table facing towards the centre (not necessarilly in the same order). Ram is third to the right of vivek. vivek is second to the right of Anil. Aakash is to the immediate right of Anil. Kamal is not the immediate neighbour of Vivek. Who is the immediate neighbor of Kamal and Vivek both?
questions.solution:
Six teachers Anil, Kamal, Ram, Sanjay, Aakash and Vivek are sitting around a circular table facing towards the centre (not necessarilly in the same order).

1) Ram is third to the right of vivek and vivek is second to the right of Anil.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/d3ee8b305de8abc278bbb5e2dbb9b4393dab7b0e0d28a175344d0d91788af689.png] [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/98e42836ea9efe9827830864f0fd413460d156bea61ed5e1c5a8e2da8c9bf0e4.png] 

2) Aakash is to the immediate right of Anil and Kamal is not the immediate neighbour of Vivek.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/582a68fe717e519e956baf40b4ade39d624ab6784cac60cf65551c8759062f02.png] [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/1f32fb39f5f91004534b75f07aadc7f1035fb8af21c6debf8c226ad934993f92.png] 

∴ Here, Sanjay is the immediate neighbor of Kamal and Vivek both.

Hence, the correct answer is **"Sanjay".**
